value.name: Rosa presses seal flat
value.description: From the back seat, Rosa leans forward and presses her palm over the notary's seal against the dashboard, holding it there without reacting to Asha.
evidence: From the back seat Rosa leaned forward between them and set her palm flat over the notary's seal, pressing it down against the dashboard the way she had once pressed linens flat on the kitchen table, and she did not lift her hand when Asha looked at her.

value.name: Asha states evidence is all they can prove
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that the documents represent everything they can prove and slides a pen toward her.
evidence: "It is everything we can prove," Asha said, meeting Lucia's eyes, and slid a pen across the dashboard until it stopped against Lucia's fingertips.

value.name: Lucia refuses the pen
value.description: Lucia does not take the pen and withdraws her hand into her cardigan pocket, visibly recoiling from the implication of the evidence.
evidence: She drew her hand slowly off the page and let it fall back into the empty pocket of her cardigan, and her face went the kind of blank that happens when a person has heard exactly what she expected and finds the hearing of it worse than she had braced for.

value.name: Rosa urges signing
value.description: Rosa pushes the top affidavit toward Lucia and insists that the ink will not dry until they sign.
evidence: From the back seat Rosa lifted her palm from the seal, the embossed disc still warm where she had pressed it, and nudged the topmost affidavit forward across the vinyl until its edge touched Lucia's wrist.

"The ink doesn't dry until we sign," she said, quietly, in the voice she used for things that were not negotiable, and the windshield kept beading at its edges while none of them moved to pick up the pen.

value.name: Asha physically supports Lucia
value.description: Asha covers Lucia's hand and nudges the pen closer, trying to coax her into signing without forcing her.
evidence: Asha laid her hand over Lucia's where it rested at the edge of the affidavit, not pressing, only covering, and with her other hand she nudged the pen the last inch until it touched the side of Lucia's thumb.

value.name: Lucia hesitates before yielding
value.description: Lucia remains motionless for a long moment before beginning to draw her hand away, signaling a reluctant shift toward signing.
evidence: Lucia did not move for a long moment; then she drew her hand
